_doc: Shrink-only accepted-list of released versions whose tag is present but points OUTSIDE the published history (GHI #829). Seeded 2026-08-18 at the population measured on main. Every entry is a legitimate release orphaned by the 2026-04-19 filter-repo rewrite and force-push named in AGENTS.md Local Agent Rules -- the tags survived, their commits did not, so reachability from refs/remotes/origin/main is unprovable for them by construction. The boundary is exact and was measured, not assumed: v0.25.11 (2026-04-18 20:12) is unreachable, v0.25.12 (2026-04-19 06:37) is reachable, and every version on either side follows. An entry exempts a version from the REACHABILITY arm ONLY -- the tag must still exist, so a deleted historical tag is still refused. NEVER add an entry to silence a release tagged after the cutover; retag at the commit that landed and push it, which is the GHI #828 repair. The list is shrink-only: entries are surrendered, never added. Enforced by src/gzkit/governance/trust_audits/release.py::audit_version_release. AMENDED 2026-08-19 (GHI #830), the ONLY legitimate growth this list admits. The set is not a fixed roster of versions; it is the INTERSECTION of two rosters -- releases RELEASE_NOTES.md documents, and tags the rewrite orphaned. GHI #830 backfilled three releases the notes had never documented (v0.18.1, v0.24.1, v0.25.1), all tagged BEFORE the 2026-04-19 cutover, so the intersection moved through no change in any tag's condition -- they were always orphaned, merely invisible while the roster omitted them. Two of the three were REPAIRED rather than exempted: v0.18.1 retagged at c1392fcde and v0.24.1 at 6b86bdf07, each an identical-tree commit on origin/main, the same repair GHI #828 applied to v0.7.0. Only v0.25.1 is added here, because no surviving commit carries its tree. Growth is admissible ONLY on this shape: a pre-cutover release entering the documented roster for the first time, with the repair attempted and unavailable. A release tagged after the cutover is still NEVER admissible.

measurement.population_derivation: Versions = every `## vX.Y.Z` heading in RELEASE_NOTES.md, the operator-facing declaration of what shipped. Reachability = `git merge-base --is-ancestor v<ver>^{commit} refs/remotes/origin/main`, a local check; GHI #205 scoped network out of this audit.
measurement.note: v0.7.0 is NOT in this list despite predating the rewrite. Its tag was local-only and pointed at an unpushed orphan; GHI #828 retagged it at 61f04d138, the surviving post-rewrite commit carrying the identical tree, so it is genuinely reachable and needs no exemption.
measurement.amendment_2026_08_19: GHI #830 backfilled v0.18.1, v0.24.1, v0.25.1 into RELEASE_NOTES.md, taking the roster 68 -> 71. v0.18.1 and v0.24.1 were retagged at identical-tree commits on origin/main (c1392fcde, 6b86bdf07) and are genuinely reachable; only v0.25.1 needed an entry, so the list went 33 -> 34.
measurement.repair_headroom_2026_08_19: Measured, not assumed: 22 of the 33 seeded entries have an identical-tree commit on origin/main and are repairable by the v0.7.0 method. The 11 that are not (v0.25.0 through v0.25.11) are the contiguous block filter-repo actually rewrote, so no surviving tree matches. The list is shrink-only and this is the shrink path; the sweep is filed as a GHI rather than taken here.
